Title: [AUTH-001] Verify successful registration with valid email, password, and display name
Preconditions: FinTrack backend is running on http://localhost:8080 and PostgreSQL is healthy. Email 'tester_a@fintrack.local' does not exist in DB.
Section Description: User registration, authentication, token validation, and multi-tenancy isolation
Steps: Send POST request to /api/v1/auth/register with JSON body: {"email": "tester_a@fintrack.local", "password": "Password123!", "display_name": "QA Tester A"}.
Expected Result: HTTP Status is 201 Created. Response JSON contains 'id' (valid UUIDv4), 'email': 'tester_a@fintrack.local', 'display_name': 'QA Tester A', and valid ISO timestamps 'created_at' and 'updated_at'. Password hash is NOT exposed in response.
